name: lab_we
notes: Inclusive we, short methods sentences, few hedges.
paragraphs: We record dim-light melatonin onset ninety minutes before habitual bedtime and treat that marker as the phase reference.
We therefore keep the light history log and discard sessions in which the subject reports evening screens without filters.
When the schedule is delayed by four hours, the marker tracks the delay, which is consistent with a light-sensitive oscillator.
The remaining onsets still shift with the imposed delay, and the group mean remains stable across two repeats.
